caption: Review cleaning log
source_note: Source: Google Play (23 September 2026) and Apple App Store (24 September 2026); authors' cleaning code. Text was normalised (Unicode compatibility composition, diacritics removed, lower case) before two rules flagged loan advertising and referral farming. The referral rule fires only where a referral phrase sits next to a code or reward amount and passes 37 test cases. Copy-and-paste duplicates of 20 characters or more were removed, and identical short reviews by different people were kept. VPS is its 1,200 most recent Google Play reviews, from 27 March 2023.

caption: Findex indicators for selected segments, Vietnam, 2024 fieldwork (per cent of adults)
source_note: Source: World Bank (2025); authors' indices. Index A averages six indicators of formally held surplus (saving at an institution, monthly saving into an account, storing money in an account, receiving interest, saving for old age, covering two months without income). Index B averages six indicators of digital habit (digitally enabled account, daily internet use, smartphone, weekly card or mobile payment in store, checking a balance by phone, wages into an account). Segment population shares are recovered from the survey itself.

caption: Segment ranks under four weighting schemes
source_note: Source: authors' calculations from Table E1 and the full twelve-segment data. Each criterion is min-max normalised across the twelve segments. Weights on (Index A, Index B, gap, adults with an account but no saving, wage receipt, saving for old age) are 1,1,1,1,1,1 (equal); 3,1,1,1,2,2 (value-heavy); 1,1,1,3,1,1 (scale-heavy); and 1,3,2,1,1,1 (reach-heavy). With about 1,000 interviews, the 15-to-24 group rests on roughly 180 respondents, so small differences in rank sit within sampling error.
